Scientific Instruments Change - Fourchu
Subsurface mooring deployed near Fox Island in the vicinity of 45 21.745N 061 08.636W. Mooring consists of an acoustic receiver housed in a modified lobster trap that sits on bottom and is attached to a buoyant plastic barrel containing 100m of line and an acoustic release. The barrel floats approximately 3m above bottom, mooring is deployed at 53m depth. Caution.
